description: This file defines several protocols, type aliases, and extensions related to device services such as camera, location, screen recording, device status, photos, contacts, calendar, reminders, motion, and watch messaging. It acts as a shared interface layer for interaction with hardware and system services in the application.

classes.name: CameraController
classes.description: Extension that conforms CameraController to the CameraServicing protocol.

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: Extension that conforms ScreenRecordService to the ScreenRecordingServicing protocol.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: Extension that conforms LocationService to the LocationServicing protocol.
